summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by iQIYI, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release with financial highlights such as total revenues of RMB6.23 billion, operating loss of RMB228.4 million, and net loss attributable to iQIYI of RMB294.6 million. It mentions a proposed listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and a share repurchase program but provides no specific terms or binding commitments. The filing is a routine earnings report with no special-situation event.
